_ConnectionStrings_note: Never commit real credentials here. Local development: put them in the git-ignored appsettings.Local.json, which is loaded automatically and never published. Servers: supply ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection / ConnectionStrings__MasterConnection as environment variables.

Jwt._Secret_note: Do NOT commit a real secret here. Provide it via the Jwt__Secret environment variable (or user-secrets). Startup aborts outside Development if this is empty, <32 chars, or a placeholder.

Lease._GraceDays_note: Days a terminal keeps working PAST the subscription's CurrentPeriodEnd. 0 = block exactly at expiry (chosen 2026-07-24). Raising it re-grants the buffer on the next lease refresh; it is not baked into already-issued leases.
